notes: «عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا» : the transmitter is one of two Imams; the text names both after «يعني», so they are written as alternatives in one level
which of the two the saying came from is not settled by the text, so a ruling is needed
the saying is the Imam's own words after «قال»; the «عليه السلام» blessing is not a surface
